unit.why: An anecdote: the tzaddik's wife rebukes him for giving to his opponents, and he answers with a homiletic explanation.

stories.start_quote: הי׳ דרכו בקודש להעניק לאנשי ריבו
stories.summary_en: The tzaddik used to give generously to his opponents. His wife Sarah, daughter of R. Zvi of Zhidachov, urged him to punish them instead. He answered that the world stands on whoever keeps silent during a quarrel, and that this, not his being a tzaddik, is why people support him.
